title: Reborn!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Timid, hapless middle schooler Tsuna Sawada learns he is heir to the Vongola mafia family, and an infant hitman named Reborn arrives to train him, using the Dying Will Bullet to force him past his fears. Tsuna gathers friends such as Gokudera, Yamamoto and Hibari as his Guardians and fights rival families, the Varia and the future villain Byakuran, finally choosing to lead the family in a new way.
life_message: It holds up loyalty to friends and the courage to protect them, even for someone who starts out weak.

content.note: Guns, bombs and super-powered mafia battles; reviewers call it much more violent after volume 8 (Wikipedia; AniList Mafia 93%, Super Power).
Darker Future arc and Varia battles (Wikipedia; to verify).
Tsuna's crush on Kyoko; Dying Will mode strips him to underwear (to verify).
Bullying and low self-esteem of 'No-Good Tsuna' (MangaUpdates Bullying; to verify).
Infant hitman shooting people, kids with dynamite, mafia shown as cool (Wikipedia; to verify).
Large Jump franchise with games and merchandise.

delivery.evidence: Loyalty and courage carried by Tsuna's fights for friends; no review on delivery found (to verify).
delivery.note: A friendship-based view of leadership is set against ruthless rival bosses through plot outcomes.

winners_losers: Tsuna and his Guardians win by loyalty; ruthless bosses like Xanxus and Byakuran lose. Sympathy goes to a gentler, friendship-based version of family power.
